data.narrative:
Corvus Robotics is a Series C robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $28.2M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a comp set of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable, all operating in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector at Series B through Series D stages. Key private comps include Exotec ($2.0B, Series D), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B, Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B, Series B), Hadrian ($1.6B, Series D), and Generalist AI ($2.0B, Series B).

Two primary methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised ($28.2M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.7x multiplier typical for Series C-to-next-stage progression, yields $48M. Peer-median analysis across the 7 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produces a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $2.0B. This wider peer range reflects heterogeneity in funding stages and company maturity within the robotics sector.

Triangulation across both methods supports a range of $41M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $849M. The substantial spread reflects material uncertainty: stage-progression favors the lower bound given limited historical raises, while peer medians anchor toward $1.6B, suggesting meaningful upside if Corvus tracks peer-level traction. Key uncertainties include actual revenue/profitability metrics, competitive positioning within the robotics value chain, and whether current-stage momentum justifies peer-median positioning.
